body: # 13 High Dividend ETFs for 2026: Top Passive Income. **Gotrade News -** Morningstar just released its list of 13 High Dividend ETFs that are prime targets for passive income strategies in 2026. This adds a layer of safety for investors looking to avoid "yield traps" often found in high-risk stocks. 1. Vanguard Dividend Appreciation ETF (VIG) · 2. Vanguard High Dividend Yield ETF (VYM) · 3. iShares Core Dividend Growth ETF (DGRO).

These two high-quality dividend ETFs are built to deliver years of durable and predictable passive income. With the U.S. economy looking uncertain and the Iran war adding another wild card to the mix, investors are starting to find comfort in more durable, defensive stocks that generate plenty of cash. This pair of dividend ETFs below has a long history of paying and growing dividends, and they're perfect if you want to set up a lifetime stream of passive income. The **Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF** (SCHD 0.38%) might be the gold standard of dividend ETFs. This ETF targets stocks with a combination of strong balance sheet health, long dividend payment histories, and high yields. By looking for companies delivering the best combination of high yield, balance sheet strength, and dividend growth, you end up with an elite portfolio of dividend stocks that can deliver for years to come. The **Vanguard Dividend Appreciation ETF** (VIG 0.74%) is more of a pure dividend growth fund and looks for companies with 10-plus consecutive years of increasing their annual dividends.
